name: dsh-quote-annotate-pro
description: Selection quoting and anchored annotations for DSH: the composer and the transcript render a compact quote block you can click to jump back to the source and highlight it, while the model still receives the exact turn, role and text. · 划词批注与引用锚点：输入框与消息里只显示紧凑引用块，点一下跳回原文并高亮；发给模型的引用仍标明轮次与角色。（纯客户端，不访问外部服务）
